engine.label: built in
engine.title: Bowed Strings
engine.summary: bowed strings: friction-driven waveguide strings, modal body, section (9 presets)

params.name: gain
params.label: Level
params.hover: The overall loudness of the sound. Range 0 to 4.

params.name: force_lo
params.label: Bow force, light
params.hover: The bow's force against its speed at a light touch: low is airy, high bites. Range 0.3 to 1.6.

params.name: force_hi
params.label: Bow force, full
params.hover: The bow's force against its speed at a full press: above about 1.1 it turns raucous. Range 0.3 to 1.6.

params.name: force_over
params.label: Bow grit
params.hover: The grit added when pressing beyond a full press: 0 none. Range 0 to 2.

params.name: speed_curve
params.label: Bow speed curve
params.hover: How the bow speed follows pressure: 0 even, 1 the loud end opens up faster. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: rosin
params.label: Rosin
params.hover: The bow's grainy noise texture. Range 0 to 0.2.

params.name: pos
params.label: Bow position
params.hover: Where the bow sits on the string, as a fraction of its length from the bridge: small is bright and glassy, large is soft and dark. Range 0.05 to 0.2.

params.name: pos_tilt
params.label: Position by timbre
params.hover: How far timbre moves the bow: up towards the bridge, down towards the fingerboard. Range 0 to 1.5 octaves.

params.name: pos_press
params.label: Position by pressure
params.hover: How far a light bow drifts towards the fingerboard. Range 0 to 1 octaves.

params.name: damp
params.label: String ring
params.hover: How long the string rings on its own, measured on a low note. Range 0.5 to 10 s.

params.name: bright
params.label: Brightness
params.hover: How sharp the string's corners are: above 1 brighter, below 1 rounder. Range 0.3 to 3.

params.name: tone_lo
params.label: Treble, light
params.hover: The treble at a light touch. Range 0 to 3.

params.name: tone_hi
params.label: Treble, full
params.hover: The treble at a full press. Range 0 to 3.

params.name: body_size
params.label: Body size
params.hover: The size of the body: 1 a violin, 0.8 a viola, 0.45 a cello, 0.3 a bass. Range 0.2 to 1.5.

params.name: body_track
params.label: Body follows register
params.hover: Whether the body shrinks for low notes: 0 a fixed body, 1 it follows the note. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: body_amt
params.label: Body
params.hover: How much of the resonant body you hear. Range 0 to 2.

params.name: body_q
params.label: Body sharpness
params.hover: How sharp the body's resonances are. Range 0.3 to 3.

params.name: hill
params.label: Bridge hill
params.hover: The brilliance of the bridge hill, a violin body's 2 to 3 kHz glow. Range 0 to 3.

params.name: direct
params.label: Direct string
params.hover: How much of the string you hear without the body. Range 0 to 2.

params.name: acc_force
params.label: Accent
params.hover: How much firmer the bow bites at a strike: the start's scratch and bite. Range 0 to 3.

params.name: acc_time
params.label: Accent length
params.hover: How long the accent lasts before the note settles. Range 0.002 to 0.2 s.

params.name: acc_noise
params.label: Accent noise
params.hover: The extra bow noise at a strike. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: acc_bright
params.label: Accent brightness
params.hover: How much brighter the start of a struck note is than the sustain. Range 0 to 2.

params.name: rel
params.label: Release
params.hover: How long the string rings after a slow release, when the bow stops on the string. Range 0.02 to 3 s.

params.name: rel_ped
params.label: Release with pedal
params.hover: How much longer the release gets with the sustain pedal down. Range 0 to 10 s.

params.name: rel_lift
params.label: Release on a lift
params.hover: How much longer the string rings after a quick lift-off, as a multiplier on the release. Range 0 to 20.

params.name: vibrato
params.label: Vibrato
params.hover: The depth of the automatic vibrato that sets in after the note starts. Range 0 to 60.

params.name: vib_hz
params.label: Vibrato rate
params.hover: How fast the vibrato wavers. Range 2 to 9 Hz.

params.name: vib_delay
params.label: Vibrato delay
params.hover: How long after the start the vibrato reaches its full depth. Range 0 to 2 s.

params.name: life
params.label: Life
params.hover: Micro-randomness: 0 every note identical, 1 each one slightly different. Range 0 to 1.

params.name: tremolo
params.label: Tremolo by shake
params.hover: How much a shake (the motion input) moves the bow; a strong shake reverses it into a tremolo. Range 0 to 2.

params.name: body_rot
params.label: Body by rotation
params.hover: How far rotation (the motion input) shifts the body resonances, in octaves. Range -2 to 2 octaves.

params.name: ensemble
params.label: Section
params.hover: The level of two more players on the note: 0 solo. Range 0 to 1.5.

params.name: ens_detune
params.label: Section detune
params.hover: How far the extra players wander from the pitch. Range 0 to 25 cents.

params.name: ens_spread
params.label: Section spread
params.hover: How far apart in time the extra players play. Range 2 to 25 ms.

params.name: pizz
params.label: Pizzicato
params.hover: Plucked instead of bowed: on or off. Range off or on.

params.name: pizz_decay
params.label: Pluck ring
params.hover: How long a plucked note rings while held, measured on middle C. Range 0.1 to 5 s.

params.name: pizz_bright
params.label: Pluck sharpness
params.hover: How sharp the pluck is: higher is brighter. Range 0.2 to 5.

params.name: output
params.label: Output
params.hover: The output level after the engine: at 1 the engine's own level, 0 silent. Range 0 to 2.
